threads.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
threads.body: Bot-only thread — no human threads exist.

instructions: Journal key decisions or rejections with URLs or IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to a one-line outcome; run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_bot_only --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --resolve-thread-ids PRRT_bot_only --require-sha HEAD`
